description: Agent rules (spec 9.4). Each case: the wallet's rules, what the agent already used and holds in open offers in the current period (mojos per asset), and the effect of one request as the wallet decoded it (what leaves the user and what arrives, mojos; the fee in XCH mojos; for a create, the offer's expiresAt). expect: allowed, or the refusal (error code and data.reason). The checks run in the order of the spec's table and the first that fails is the answer; a cancel of the agent's own offer is only checked for its fee. Amounts are decimal strings of mojos; XCH has 12 decimals, a CAT 3. Prices are quote units per base unit, compared exactly.
provenance: Written by hand with the rules of spec 9.4 and checked by the test wallet of agent-mcp (agent-mcp/test/vectors.test.ts) until the wallet kit implements agent rules (clapandpay-backlog TASK-143).
